cards.text: It's just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knows His hour has come to leave this world and return to the Father. He has loved His own who were in the world. And friend, you're about to see just how far that love goes.

cards.question: Jesus' hour has come to leave this world. How far does His love for His own go?

cards.text: The evening meal is underway, and something has already been put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot and one of the Twelve (John 6:71). It's to betray Jesus, and friend, that makes me set my whisk DOWN.

cards.question: Someone has put it into the heart of Judas to betray Jesus. Who?

cards.text: Now look at what Jesus KNOWS, friend: the Father has delivered ALL things into His hands.

cards.question: Jesus knows the Father has put all things into His hands and that He is returning to God. True or false: He also knows He came from God.

cards.text: So He gets up from the supper, lays aside His outer garments, and wraps a towel around His waist. Friend, if somebody put ALL things in MY hands, I'd be out on a balcony waving at the crowd with my mustache, and HE picks up a towel.
Then He pours out some water and begins to wash the disciples' feet, one after another, drying them with the towel around Him.

cards.question: To wash the disciples' feet, Jesus pours water into a ___.

cards.text: Then He comes to Simon Peter, one of His disciples, who asks, "Lord, are You going to wash my feet?" I bet his eyebrows are up as high as MINE.

cards.question: Jesus answers Peter's question. True or false: Jesus tells Peter that later he will understand what Jesus is doing.
Jesus tells Peter he will understand later. How does Peter answer Jesus?

answers.text: He says Jesus will never wash his feet
He asks to wash Jesus' feet first
He says he will wait until later

cards.text: Peter tells Him, "Never shall You wash my feet!" Picture the CEO of your company walking over to wipe off YOUR desk, and you diving across the room like, NO sir, NOT happening.
Jesus answers him, "Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me." Friend, that's not a small thing to hear.

cards.question: Peter hears that unless Jesus washes him, he has no part with Jesus. What does Peter ask for now?

answers.text: His hands and head washed too

cards.text: Peter just went from NEVER to hands AND head, and friend, I respect a man who goes ALL in. Jesus tells him that whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean.

cards.question: Jesus has just told Peter that whoever has bathed needs only his feet washed. True or false: Jesus then says every one of the disciples is clean.
Jesus tells the disciples that not all of them are clean. Why does He say that?

answers.text: He knew who would betray Him

cards.text: When He's finished washing their feet, Jesus puts His outer garments back on and reclines with them again. Then He asks, "Do you know what I have done for you?" and I bet nobody at that table wants to answer first.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells the disciples they're right to call Him Teacher and Lord.
Their Lord and Teacher just washed their feet. So what does Jesus say the disciples should do?

answers.text: Never let Him do it again

cards.text: Jesus says He has set them an example, so they should do as He has done for them. He didn't hand them a pamphlet on serving, friend; He handed them clean feet.
Then Jesus says, "Truly, truly, I tell you…" and He talks about who is greater than whom. Friend, when Jesus says it twice, I put down EVERYTHING and listen.

cards.question: Jesus says no servant is greater than his master, nor is a ___ greater than the one who sent him.
True or false: Jesus says the disciples will be blessed just for knowing what He has taught them, even if they don't do it.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He isn't speaking about all of them. He knows whom He has chosen, and after that Judas detail at supper, I'm watching this table VERY closely.

cards.question: Jesus quotes Psalm 41:9 about someone who "has lifted up his heel against Me." Who does it say that is?

answers.text: A servant of the high priest

cards.question: Jesus says He is telling the disciples this now, before it happens. Why?

answers.text: So that they can stop it
So that they will tell others

cards.text: Then comes one more "Truly, truly, I tell you…" Jesus says whoever receives the one He sends receives Him.

cards.question: Jesus says receiving His messenger means receiving Him. So whoever receives Jesus receives whom?

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave this table for now. Friend, this night is FAR from over, so stay close to me.
